answer: Liveness-signed work ledger.** Each identity is a keypair that must publish a continuous heartbeat: decrypt a rotating challenge, do a fixed unit of useful computation, and countersign within the window. A missed beat orphans the identity and its accrued reputation. The node must also echo the prior challenge into its next proof, chaining history so a clone army can't fork cheaply. Every extra identity is another parallel sonnet of real CPU-seconds and uptime held open; the ledger flags account creation whose per-day lantern burns faster than measured useful output.
